Notes to the Statement of Consolidated Financial Results
1. The above consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, have been prepared by the Parent Company in accordance with Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015, as amended and were reviewed by the Audit Committee and thereafter were approved and taken on record by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 04, 2026.
2. The Statutory Auditors of the Parent Company have carried out a limited review and issued an unmodified conclusion on the above consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
3. Based on the management approach as defined under Ind AS 108 Operating Segments, the Chief Operating Decision Maker CODM evaluates the Group s performance and allocates resources based on an various business indicators. The Group is primarily engaged in manufacturing and selling and trading of steel products, which is recognised as the sole reportable business segment. Accordingly, segment-wise information is not separately disclosed.
4. During the previous quarter ended June 30, 2026, the operations of the Parent Company s manufacturing unit situated at SIPCOT Industrial Growth Centre, Perundurai, Erode District, Tamil Nadu, were temporarily suspended pursuant to directions issued by the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board TNPCB, impacting the Group s revenue and profitability.
Subsequently, pursuant to proceedings issued by TNPCB dated July 13, 2026, the earlier closure directions were suspended and power supply was restored, enabling the Parent Company to recommence operations at the said unit from July 13, 2026.
5. Pursuant to the approval of the Board of Directors and the shareholders of the Parent Company, 15,00,000 convertible warrants were allotted on a preferential basis on July 27, 2026 at an issue price of Rs.343.03 per warrant, aggregating to Rs.5,145.45 lakhs, convertible into 15,00,000 equity shares of face value of Rs. 10 each at a premium of Rs. 333.03 per equity share.
The Parent Company received Rs.1,286.36 lakhs, representing 25 percent of the total issue consideration. The balance 75 percent is payable upon exercise of the conversion option within 18 months from the date of allotment, i.e., on or before January 27, 2028.
6. During the quarter, the Parent Company s subsidiary, Hariom Power and Energy Private Limited, commissioned a 5 MW AC solar power plant in Maharashtra.
7. The above consolidated unaudited financial results of the Group are available on the Parent Company s website www.hariompipes.com and also on the websites of BSE Limited i.e. www.bseindia.com and National Stock Exchange of India Limited, where the equity shares of the Company are listed.
